summary.from: Contra 1.d4, un esquema sólido que sirve casi siempre: ...d5, ...e6, ...Cf6, ...Ae7 y enroque. Las ramas muestran que el plan apenas cambia según lo que juegan las blancas.
summary.to: Against 1.d4, a solid setup that almost always works: ...d5, ...e6, ...Nf6, ...Be7 and castling. The branches show that the plan barely changes whatever White plays.

steps.0.note.from: Las blancas ocupan el centro con el peón de dama.
steps.0.note.to: White occupies the centre with the queen’s pawn.

steps.1.note.from: Respuesta simétrica: tu peón frena el avance blanco y ocupa el centro.
steps.1.note.to: Symmetrical reply: your pawn stops White’s advance and occupies the centre.

steps.2.note.from: El Gambito de Dama: ofrecen un peón para desviar tu peón de d5.
steps.2.note.to: The Queen’s Gambit: White offers a pawn to deflect your d5 pawn.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan sin jugar c4.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas abren paso a su alfil de f1.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: White opens the way for their f1 bishop.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Tú también: el mismo esquema de siempre.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You too: the same setup as always.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: El alfil blanco apunta hacia tu enroque.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: The white bishop aims at your castled king.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Golpeas el centro blanco desde un lado antes de que avancen e4.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You strike at White’s centre from the side before they push e4.

steps.2.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: Desarrollas y aumentas la presión sobre d4.
steps.2.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: You develop and increase the pressure on d4.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas sacan el alfil antes de cerrarlo con e3.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.0.note.to: White brings the bishop out before shutting it in with e3.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas forman su cadena de peones.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.3.note.from: Tu esquema de siempre: abres paso al alfil de f8.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.3.note.to: Your usual setup: you open the way for the f8 bishop.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.6.note.from: El alfil blanco apunta hacia tu enroque.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.6.note.to: The white bishop aims at your castled king.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.9.note.from: Atacas el centro blanco por el lado.
steps.2.branches.1.steps.9.note.to: You attack White’s centre from the side.

steps.2.branches.1.steps.11.note.to: You develop and put pressure on d4.

steps.3.note.from: Rehúsas el gambito: sostienes d5 con un peón y abres paso al alfil de f8.
steps.3.note.to: You decline the gambit: you hold d5 with a pawn and open the way for the f8 bishop.

steps.4.note.from: Las blancas presionan d5 con otra pieza.
steps.4.note.to: White puts pressure on d5 with another piece.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan el caballo de rey.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas preparan el alfil en g2, apuntando al centro y al flanco de dama.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: White prepares the bishop on g2, aiming at the centre and the queenside.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: El alfil blanco ya mira hacia d5 y b7.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: The white bishop already eyes d5 and b7.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: Aquí sí tomas el peón: obligas a la dama blanca a perder tiempo para recuperarlo.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: Here you do take the pawn: you force the white queen to lose time winning it back.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: La dama va a recuperar el peón de c4.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: The queen goes to win back the c4 pawn.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Preparas ...b5 para defender el peón o ganar espacio.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You prepare ...b5 to defend the pawn or gain space.

steps.4.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: Desarrollas el alfil; si toman en c4, irá a c6 contra el alfil de g2.
steps.4.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: You develop the bishop; if they take on c4, it will go to c6 against the g2 bishop.

steps.5.note.from: Desarrollas y defiendes d5 otra vez.
steps.5.note.to: You develop and defend d5 again.

steps.6.note.from: El alfil clava tu caballo contra la dama.
steps.6.note.to: The bishop pins your knight to the queen.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas cambian en el centro.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.1.note.from: Recuperas con el peón de e: tu alfil de c8 queda libre.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You recapture with the e-pawn: your c8 bishop is freed.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You break the pin by developing.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: Las blancas abren paso a su otro alfil.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: White opens the way for their other bishop.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.5.note.from: Refuerzas d5 y das a tu dama la diagonal hacia a5 y b6.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: You reinforce d5 and give your queen the diagonal towards a5 and b6.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.6.note.from: La dama blanca vigila h7 y e4.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.6.note.to: The white queen watches h7 and e4.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: Desarrollas el otro caballo sin tapar el peón de c.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: You develop the other knight without blocking the c-pawn.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: El alfil blanco apunta a h7.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: The white bishop aims at h7.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan su último caballo.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.from: El caballo va a e2 para dejar libre el peón de f.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.to: The knight goes to e2 to free the f-pawn.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.from: La torre a la columna e.
El caballo defiende h7 y puede ir a g6 o e6.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.to: The knight defends h7 and can go to g6 or e6.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.from: Las blancas preparan e4 para romper en el centro.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.to: White prepares e4 to break in the centre.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.from: El alfil vigila d5 y e4 desde atrás.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.10.branches.0.s.to: The bishop watches d5 and e4 from behind.

steps.6.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: La torre a la columna e, la que está semiabierta para ti.
steps.6.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: The rook to the e-file, the one that is half-open for you.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan antes de decidir dónde va el alfil.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.0.note.to: White develops before deciding where the bishop goes.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.note.from: El alfil va a f4 en lugar de g5.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.note.to: The bishop goes to f4 instead of g5.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Las blancas abren paso a su alfil de f1.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: White opens the way for their f1 bishop.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: El alfil blanco apunta a h7.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: The white bishop aims at h7.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Cambias cuando el alfil ya se ha movido.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: You exchange once the bishop has already moved.
The bishop wins the pawn back.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.from: Golpeas el centro blanco por el lado.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.2.branches.0.st.to: You strike at White’s centre from the side.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.4.note.from: Las blancas abren paso a su otro alfil.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.4.note.to: White opens the way for their other bishop.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.5.note.from: Golpeas el centro blanco por el lado.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.5.note.to: You strike at White’s centre from the side.

steps.6.branches.1.steps.7.note.from: Recuperas el peón con el alfil activo.
steps.6.branches.1.steps.7.note.to: You win the pawn back with an active bishop.

steps.7.note.from: Rompes la clavada y preparas el enroque.
steps.7.note.to: You break the pin and prepare castling.

steps.8.note.from: Las blancas abren paso a su alfil de f1.
steps.8.note.to: White opens the way for their f1 bishop.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas cambian el alfil por tu caballo.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: White trades the bishop for your knight.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.1.note.from: Recuperas con el alfil: tienes la pareja de alfiles.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You recapture with the bishop: you have the bishop pair.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: Las blancas abren paso a su otro alfil.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: White opens the way for their other bishop.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.5.note.from: Primero refuerzas d5: si sacaras ya el caballo a d7, taparía a tu dama.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: First you reinforce d5: if you brought the knight out to d7 right now, it would block your queen.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.6.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan su último alfil.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: Ahora sí: el caballo sale y prepara ...e5.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: Now is the time: the knight comes out and prepares ...e5.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Cambias cuando el alfil ya se ha movido.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You exchange once the bishop has already moved.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.10.note.to: The bishop wins the pawn back.

steps.8.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: Liberas tu posición: tus alfiles ganan diagonales.
steps.8.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: You free your position: your bishops gain diagonals.

steps.9.note.from: Rey a salvo antes de liberar tu posición.
steps.9.note.to: King safe before freeing your position.

steps.10.note.from: Las blancas completan el desarrollo de los caballos.
steps.10.note.to: White completes the development of the knights.

steps.11.note.from: El caballo se desarrolla sin tapar el peón de c, que avanzará luego.
steps.11.note.to: The knight develops without blocking the c-pawn, which will advance later.

steps.12.note.from: La torre blanca a la columna c, que podría abrirse.
steps.12.note.to: The white rook to the c-file, which could open up.

steps.12.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan el alfil antes que la torre.
steps.12.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: White develops the bishop before the rook.

steps.12.branches.0.steps.1.note.from: Cambias: el alfil tiene que volver a moverse.
steps.12.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You exchange: the bishop has to move again.

steps.12.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: The bishop wins the pawn back.

steps.12.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Golpeas el centro blanco por el lado.
steps.12.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You strike at White’s centre from the side.

steps.12.branches.0.steps.5.note.from: Preparas ...b5 para ganar espacio en el flanco de dama.
steps.12.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: You prepare ...b5 to gain space on the queenside.

steps.12.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: Las blancas quedan con un peón aislado en d4.
steps.12.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: White is left with an isolated pawn on d4.

steps.12.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: El caballo vigila d5, la casilla delante del peón aislado.
steps.12.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: The knight watches d5, the square in front of the isolated pawn.

steps.13.note.from: Refuerzas d5 y cierras la columna c.
steps.13.note.to: You reinforce d5 and close the c-file.

steps.14.note.from: Las blancas desarrollan su último alfil.

steps.15.note.from: Cambias cuando el alfil ya se ha movido: tendrá que volver a moverse.
steps.15.note.to: You exchange once the bishop has already moved: it will have to move again.

steps.16.note.to: The bishop wins the pawn back.

steps.17.note.from: Idea liberadora: ofreces cambiar piezas para ganar espacio.
steps.17.note.to: A freeing idea: you offer to trade pieces to gain space.

steps.19.note.from: Recuperas con la dama. Con menos piezas, tu posición respira.
steps.19.note.to: You recapture with the queen. With fewer pieces, your position can breathe.
